mil6.2.9:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, ayaṃ suriyo sabbakālaṃ kaṭhinaṃ tapati, udāhu kañci kālaṃ mandaṃ tapatīti.
mil6.2.9:1.2: Sabbakālaṃ mahārāja suriyo kaṭhinaṃ tapati, na kañci kālaṃ mandaṃ tapatīti. -
mil6.2.9:1.3: Yadi bhante Nāgasena suriyo sabbakālaṃ kaṭhinaṃ tapati, kissa pana app-ekadā suriyo kaṭhinaṃ tapati app-ekadā mandaṃ tapatīti. -
mil6.2.9:1.4: Cattāro 'me mahārāja suriyassa rogā yesaṃ aññatarena rogena patīpīḷito suriyo mandaṃ tapati,
mil6.2.9:1.6: abbhaṃ mahārāja suriyassa rogo, tena rogena patipīḷito suriyo mandaṃ tapati;
mil6.2.9:1.7: mahikā mahārāja suriyassa rogo, tena rogena patipīḷito suriyo mandaṃ tapati;
mil6.2.9:1.8: megho mahārāja suriyassa rogo, tena rogena patipīḷito suriyo mandaṃ tapati;
mil6.2.9:1.9: Rāhu mahārāja suriyassa rogo, tena rogena patipīḷito suriyo mandaṃ tapati.
mil6.2.9:1.10: Ime kho mahārāja cattāro suriyassa-rogā, tesaṃ aññatarena patipīḷito suriyo mandaṃ tapatīti. -
mil6.2.9:1.11: Acchariyaṃ bhante Nāgasena, abbhutaṃ bhante Nāgasena, suriyassa pi tāva tejosampannassa rogo uppajjissati, kimanga pana aññesaṃ sattānaṃ; na-tthi bhante esā vibhatti aññassa aññatra tavādisena buddhimatā
